about:
How Prince is being looked at in the anchor photo: how his head and body are turned and tipped relative
to the camera (owner, 2026-11-16: "place the camera about six inches away ... exactly as it was when I
captured it, and then determine what way he is being looked at").
camera: data/cameras.json anchor_front (the depth model's camera, MoGe-2)

head.meaning: turned + = toward his own left (his nose toward the picture's right); tipped + = his left side up

left_out.mouth corners: only 1.7 cm apart: a 1 mm error in depth is 3.5 deg of turn
left_out.ear bases (inner and outer): on his outline, in the outer band whose distances are least sure (inner pair: 52 deg)

nod.meaning: no photo shows his head 'level', so his nod is kept as these measured slopes; a later photo of him is compared against them. (A plane through the front of his face was tried and not used: his muzzle is round, so it depends on the window drawn.)

head_photo_only.superseded: 2026-11-18 by the head read from his measured surface ('head'). From the picture alone: his nose sits right of the middle of his eyes, but his 5 deg tip does most of that; the mirror pairs as rays swing with the lens (7.8 deg with the six-inch camera, 12.7 with this one) and lean on the mouth, lip corners and ear bases; the eye ovals differ (5.3) though the eyes' measured surfaces face equally far to each side
head_photo_only.meaning: turned + = toward his own left (his nose toward the picture's right, his right cheek nearer the camera); tipped + = his left side up (a little head tilt toward his right)

body.note: from the lowest point of each peet (view-dependent points, on a soft surface): a rough reading of his body's turn

eyes_and_nostrils_only.note: the two pairs that fit best (misfit < 0.5 deg); two pairs alone leave the turn loose

summary.tipped: his left side up, about 4 deg (measured surface 4-6; the photo alone 5): SOLID
summary.turned: hardly at all: 0.5 deg toward his left, square to the camera within about 3 deg: read from his measured surface (readings -3.2 to +2.2: his eyes, nostril wings and lip corners in 3D, the way his two eyes face, his nose against his eyes). The photo alone said 5-13 deg toward his left: it read his tip as part of a turn
summary.body: rough: about 4 deg toward his right (from his peets' lowest points)
summary.head_vs_body: his body is turned about 4 deg toward his right and his head is square to the camera, so on his body his head is turned about 5 deg toward his left, and tipped
summary.nod: the line from between his eyes to his nose slopes 40 deg below level; his eyes face about 16 deg up (measured slopes: no photo shows his head level)

camera_tilt_note: tipped is measured against the camera's level; the owner remembers holding it straight on. His peets' line does not tip the same way, so the tip is his head, not the phone
